description: Legacy AMD app: vendored require.js (2.3.7) loads define()/require() modules at runtime, no bundler. The `afterpack` CLI obfuscates dist/modules/ (docs/framework-integration.md -- CLI universal-fallback row). Proves AfterPack preserves AMD define/require semantics (globals + encoded module ids still resolve).

build.note: no bundler: build.mjs stages src/ -> dist/ then runs `afterpack ./dist/modules` (require.js itself is left pristine) -- a plain `npm run build` already emits obfuscated AMD modules

interactions.description: Clicking the counter calls the obfuscated AMD calc module's add() and re-renders.
